llm_analysis.reasoning: Google wrote these minimum qualifications deliberately broad (a BS, coursework-level DSA, one language, some AI/ML exposure), so Justin clears every one of them on paper and the keyword score of 100% is real but not informative. The signal that matters is what separates him from the other 200+ applicants: his CUDA kernel optimization and inference-compression work is genuinely above the early-career bar and lands squarely on the AI+Infrastructure org's accelerator and model-efficiency rotations. What is missing is the Cloud half of Cloud AI. Nothing in the profile touches GCP, containers, orchestration, or systems that serve real traffic, and every role he has held is research scope rather than production ownership.
